rationale: The agent correctly authenticated the user via email, viewed the user’s orders, and submitted return requests for all items in both orders to the original payment methods. The refusal to refund to the opposite payment methods was correct per policy. However, before making order-changing writes (submitting returns), the agent did not explicitly restate the exact change and obtain explicit confirmation to proceed; they proceeded immediately after the user said they wanted to return all items. Policy requires explicit confirmation prior to such actions. Final information provided about refunds going to original payment methods after processing was accurate. The missing explicit confirmation step makes this fail under the stated pass bar.
